description: This file defines a class 'VertxCoapResource' which acts as a wrapper around a Coap 'Resource' to make it compatible with Vert.x. It delegates method calls to the underlying resource and ensures that 'handleRequest' executes within the specified Vert.x context, facilitating non-blocking, asynchronous request handling in a Vert.x environment.

classes.name: VertxCoapResource
classes.description: A wrapper around a Californium CoAP Resource that executes request handling within a Vert.x context, enabling non-blocking CoAP resource implementations compatible with Vert.x event loop.

methods.name: VertxCoapResource
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a given CoAP resource with a Vert.x context, ensuring request handling executes on the specified Vert.x event loop.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the Vert.x context associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Delegates the handling of a CoAP exchange to the wrapped resource, ensuring execution occurs on the Vert.x context.
